title: MAVEN: A Multi-Agent Framework for Multicultural Text-to-Video Generation

bias_targets.methodology: Generating videos using mono-cultural and cross-cultural prompts (spanning Chinese, American, and Romanian cultures across person, action, and location dimensions) and evaluating the cultural fidelity and relevance of the outputs using CLIP-based cosine similarity against cultural grounding statements (Cultural Relevance Score) and Vision-Language Model (VLM) as-a-judge assessments.
